items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Yes. We became close friends together ever since.

ctx.x: You've got to get a lot of chumming.

Yes. We became close friends together ever since. And when Sidney came back to Paris the last time after the war, I was accepted in his room when nobody else could come up there with a walk above a few. There was one, just one, just one. One. The position that was able to see when I announced my name in the hotel where he was staying, he says, yes, let him come up. Yeah. Just like that. And I went up. The only one he never had up. Spent five hours with him talking. Talking down to me. Five hours. He told me…
Not in any of the details.
